Daniel wants to buy five notebooks at $1.50 each, which costs 5 * $1.50 = $7.50. He also wants two pens at $0.25 each, which costs 2 * $0.25 = $0.50. One calculator costs $12, and one geometry set costs $10. The total cost before the discount is $7.50 + $0.50 + $12 + $10 = $30. The shop gives a 10% discount on all the purchased items, so the discount is 10% of $30 = $3. The final amount Daniel has to spend is $30 - $3 = $27.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 27
